title: Crime, law & punishment
note: B1 Oxford-gap leaf · what happens, and what happens next · 12 items · carriers via use[] · picture intro · Use bank

intro.title: From the crime to the court
intro.body: This is the vocabulary of every news report and half the films you have ever watched, and it runs in order: something happens, the police arrest someone, the court decides, and a punishment follows. Learn it as that sequence rather than as twelve separate words.

intro.title: You will use these words in
intro.note: punish is what you do; punishment is the thing itself — the verb takes the person (punish a child), the noun does not.
